  • Constructor Details

    • SpatialConvergenceReport

      private SpatialConvergenceReport(String coarseName, String mediumName, String fineName, String branchName, TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy.ProfileQuantity quantity, int coarseSections, int mediumSections, int fineSections, double refinementRatio, double coarseMediumDifference, double mediumFineDifference, double observedOrder, double fineGridConvergenceIndex, TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy.SpatialConvergenceStatus status)
      Create one immutable convergence receipt.
      Parameters:
      coarseName - coarsest case name
      mediumName - intermediate case name
      fineName - finest case name
      branchName - compared branch name
      quantity - compared quantity
      coarseSections - coarsest section count
      mediumSections - intermediate section count
      fineSections - finest section count
      refinementRatio - constant grid refinement ratio
      coarseMediumDifference - normalized coarse-to-medium discrepancy
      mediumFineDifference - normalized medium-to-fine discrepancy
      observedOrder - observed order, or Double.NaN
      fineGridConvergenceIndex - safety-factored index, or Double.NaN
      status - explicit convergence classification
